SHIPPED: Stremio addon that auto-syncs subtitle timing using Whisnap transcription. Compare audio to subtitle text, align automatically instead of manual delay adjustment.

STATUS: Built and tested, standalone. Two blockers before public release:
1. OpenSubtitles API access — need to email opensubtitles.com/contact, explain project, get API key for public use (can't hardcode personal credentials)
2. Installation flow — needs documentation, probably desktop-only

CONTEXT: Built during edibles + stretching + Captain America session. Ned refused to manually adjust the 10-second subtitle delay and built the whole thing instead.

NEXT: Debug polish, contact OpenSubtitles, figure out install flow.
